why: Re-run, not carried forward: Stage 2A.4 corrected a defect in the lot-grid cut candidate enumeration, which moved Huntington's cut, so the Stage 2A.3 runtime evidence no longer describes this geometry.
method: 24 s of stepped runtime per world (4 areas x 6 x api.step(1)), actors released. api.step rather than real time because the Browser pane pauses requestAnimationFrame when hidden.
notes: offRoad counts samples further than halfRoad + 1.5 m from every road centreline.

onCarriageway uses d <= halfRoad, a crude proxy. Candidate 25 of 141 (17.7%) against control 19 of 136 (14.0%) is not an improvement and is not claimed as one; no pedestrian is inside a building or stranded in either world.
Spawn and core-spec counts agree exactly with the headless build, which is the cross-check that the runtime is the same world the measurements describe.
Collision was accepted in Stage 2A.2 against collider generation that Stage 2A.3 and 2A.4 did not touch; see the report for the carry-forward argument.
